method: Direct source/output review; revisable judgments, not gold labels
scope: Statement, modality, scope and choice were read against the pinned source. Record counts and valid graphs are not semantic accuracy.

cases.criterion: This section does not prohibit ammunition in checked baggage or same firearm container; additional part-175 requirements remain a reference, not invented permission free of other rules.
cases.note: The statement correctly says this section does not prohibit carriage, but kind=exemption and modality=not_required misclassify absence of a prohibition as absence of an obligation. Pair consistency and exact source evidence do not catch this.

remaining_focus: Distinguish not prohibited from not required without silently relabeling the model.
Keep independently useful meanings referenceable and repeat their full qualifications in statement and scope.
Use existing source review/refinement selectively; no evidence yet justifies a routine relationship pass.
